legacy_request.meaning: Legacy adapter: these arguments are read from the top-level JSON object even when the five kernel fields are present. The nested payload room supplies no Linker arguments.

operation.meaning: Choose the NAS operation. browse and hardlink-scan read; deploy, delete, rename and mkdir act.

path.meaning: Required for browse, hardlink-scan, delete, rename and mkdir. Resolve to the NAS root or a descendant. For mkdir this is the parent directory.

destination.meaning: Required for deploy. Destination directory under the NAS root.

sources.meaning: Required for deploy. Resolved NAS source paths.

conflict_strategy.meaning: How deploy handles existing targets. Rename does not resolve an existing top-level directory.

new_name.meaning: Required for rename. One directory name, not . or ..; the target must stay within the NAS root.

new_dir_name.meaning: Required for mkdir. One directory name, not . or ..; the target must stay within the NAS root.

operation.meaning: Operation attempted; omitted on an adapter error.

path.meaning: Resolved source, parent or listing path, depending on the operation.

entries.meaning: Directory entries from browse or hardlink-scan; inode only on hardlink-scan.

is_dir.meaning: Whether the entry is a directory.

is_hardlink.meaning: Whether the entry is a non-directory with more than one link.

success.meaning: Hardlink helper outcome for that source.

status.meaning: Native status when present; this adapter emits no firstMissingSignal and can also return ok false without a status for an unsuccessful deployment.

error.meaning: Unstructured adapter or OS diagnostic, when provided.
